ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of bacterial structure; the bacterial body is in a long oval shape, with many short hair-like protrusions around it. From the right side of the bacterium extends a very long, thin, and curved whip-like structure, next to which is marked the letter I, looking like a tail. Reasoning: The question asks "which part looks like a tail." In bacteria, this long and thin structure that is like a tail and is used for movement is called a flagellum. Therefore the answer is flagellum.
